Gpu.FormatManaged: File and shader versions are selected automatically when saving and exporting. Configure features with the controls; no version editing is required.
Gpu.Status: GPU Particle · SourceExport only · GPU runtime pending
Gpu.FutureHint: Texture simulation and compute passes are not implemented by the portable compiler.
Gpu.TexturePathHint: Engine asset object path or builtin:white
Gpu.FlowMapTypeFromInput: Output type follows the coordinate input: Float2 for UV, Float3 for world projection.
Gpu.FlowMapLinearHint: Flow maps use Linear RG data mapped from [0,1] to [-1,1]. Any Texture2D can be assigned; Linear is recommended.
Gpu.Gestures: Drag body · Pan / zoom: graph shortcut settings
Gpu.Grammar: Restricted original DSL, not VEX/HLSL: let, @attributes, param(), typed vectors and registered math; no loops or arbitrary code. Graph and text lower to the same typed IR.
Gpu.EmitterShapeHelp: Offsets the Spawn Position write around its value; without a Position write, the center is emitterPosition. This affects initial emission, not billboard drawing.
Gpu.SelectValueNodeHint: Select a value node, then choose an attribute under Writes
Gpu.FlowOrderHint: ↓ declared flow-list order · not a runtime trace
Gpu.BillboardSourceBindingPending: Billboard source binding · engine-side rendering is pending
Gpu.MoveFlowEarlierTip: Move earlier in the authored flow list
Gpu.MoveFlowLaterTip: Move later in the authored flow list
Gpu.NoCrossFlowMatch: No authored cross-flow attribute write/read match. Host uniforms are external inputs, not flow-to-flow transfers.
Gpu.StaticDependency: Static attribute dependency · not observed execution
Gpu.InvalidTransferOrder: Authored producer appears after consumer; transfer order is not valid
Gpu.FlowSummaryCompiled: Authored flow order validated by source compilation · RuntimeExecuted=false · no live trace
Gpu.FlowSummaryUncompiled: Authored flow order only · source compilation unavailable · runtime order not established
Gpu.Unsupported.NoKernel: Compute flow has no authored kernel
Gpu.Unsupported.MissingKernel: Kernel '{0}' is not present in the authored program
Gpu.Unsupported.StageMismatch: Kernel stage {0} does not match flow kind {1}
Gpu.Unsupported.BillboardKernel: Billboard render does not consume an authored compute kernel
Gpu.Unsupported.BillboardResourceMissing: Billboard render resource is missing or unresolved
Gpu.Unsupported.FlowKind: {0} is declared but not implemented by the GPU source compiler
Gpu.Unsupported.MissingResource: Resource '{0}' is not present in the authored program
Gpu.Port.BindingUnsupported: · referenced kernel only; flow binding unsupported
Gpu.Port.NoPathToWrite: · no path to a kernel write
Gpu.OpDesc.Constant: Outputs a constant scalar or vector value.
Gpu.OpDesc.ReadAttribute: Reads a per-particle attribute such as Position, Velocity, Color, or Age.
Gpu.OpDesc.ReadUniform: Reads an external host uniform such as deltaTime, time, or emitterPosition.
Gpu.OpDesc.Add: Adds two scalars or vectors (A + B).
Gpu.OpDesc.Sin: Computes the sine of an angle in radians.
Gpu.OpDesc.Cos: Computes the cosine of an angle in radians.
Gpu.OpDesc.Clamp: Clamps a value between Minimum and Maximum.
Gpu.OpDesc.Min: Returns the smaller of A and B.
Gpu.OpDesc.Max: Returns the larger of A and B.
Gpu.OpDesc.Normalize: Normalizes a vector to unit length.
Gpu.OpDesc.Length: Computes the Euclidean length of a vector.
Gpu.OpDesc.Compose: Combines scalar components (X, Y, Z, W) into a Float2, Float3, or Float4 vector.
Gpu.OpDesc.Select: Chooses True Value or False Value based on Condition.
Gpu.OpDesc.Random: Generates a deterministic pseudo-random value from a seed.
Gpu.OpDesc.Component: Extracts a single scalar component (X, Y, Z, or W) from a vector.
Gpu.OpDesc.Floor: Rounds down to the nearest integer.
Gpu.OpDesc.Ceil: Rounds up to the nearest integer.
Gpu.OpDesc.Frac: Returns the fractional part of a value (x - floor(x)).
Gpu.OpDesc.Mod: Returns the floating-point remainder of A divided by B.
Gpu.OpDesc.Sign: Returns -1, 0, or 1 indicating the sign of the value.
Gpu.OpDesc.Pow: Raises A to the power of B (A ^ B).
Gpu.OpDesc.Sqrt: Computes the square root of a value.
Gpu.OpDesc.Exp: Computes e raised to the power of the value.
Gpu.OpDesc.Log: Computes the natural logarithm of a value.
Gpu.OpDesc.Lerp: Linearly interpolates between A and B by Amount (0 to 1).
Gpu.OpDesc.Smoothstep: Smooth Hermite interpolation between Edge 0 and Edge 1.
Gpu.OpDesc.Remap: Remaps a value from Source Range to Target Range.
Gpu.OpDesc.Dot: Computes the dot product of two vectors.
Gpu.OpDesc.Cross: Computes the 3D cross product of two Float3 vectors.
Gpu.OpDesc.Distance: Computes the distance between two points.
Gpu.OpDesc.Saturate: Clamps a value to the [0, 1] range.
Gpu.OpDesc.Fbm: Samples multi-octave fractal Brownian motion (FBM) noise.
Gpu.OpDesc.CurlNoise: Computes divergence-free 3D curl noise for swirling motion.
Gpu.OpDesc.SampleFlowMap: Samples a 2D FlowMap texture using UV or world coordinates.
